daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

The DPR has formed a special working group (Panja) to supervise the investigation of three corruption cases involving Febrie Adriansyah, following the dramatic overnight resignation and naming of the former chief prosecutor for special crimes (Jampidsus) as a suspect. Commission III chairman Habiburokhman stated the oversight body would monitor search operations to ensure evidence integrity amid concerns gold bars could be switched with chocolate, while urging the Attorney General's Office to form an independent investigative team with no affiliation to Febrie. The case has been classified as mega-corruption and will be supervised by the KPK.

  • Two DPR factions called for ex-Jampidsus Febrie Adriansyah to be sentenced to death, with a Commission III member stating "if possible, he should be executed."
  • The KPK indicated it is ready to take over the Febrie Adriansyah case if the investigation stalls at the Attorney General's Office.
  • Golkar chairman Bahlil endorsed Population Minister Wihaji as the right figure to lead the MKGR party organization, and asked Golkar legislators in the DPR to safeguard the MBG (Makan Bergizi Gratis) program.
  • Bahlil instructed MKGR to rev up Golkar's political machinery ahead of the 2029 general election.
  • The KPK disclosed that Sukoharjo Regent had a "safe house" to store wealth obtained through extortion, and used the extortion proceeds to renovate his home and purchase vehicles.
  • The DPR proposed that salaries for PPPK workers in regions with low fiscal capacity be covered by the national budget (APBN).
  • KH Zulfa Mustofa declared his readiness to run as a candidate for PBNU chairman at the organization's 35th National Congress.

Foreign Policy & Defence

Indonesian Foreign Minister Sugiono paid final tribute to the late Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei in Iran, representing Indonesia at the funeral amid escalating tensions between Iran and the United States. The visit comes as Indonesia seeks to maintain diplomatic ties with Tehran during a volatile period in the Middle East.

  • Indonesia purchased two defense systems from India, comprising BrahMos and Astra missiles, prompting questions about the appropriateness of the procurement policy.
  • State-owned defense company Pindad will manufacture rifles for the Saudi Arabian military.
  • Indonesia and Morocco discussed the implementation of their halal certification agreement.
  • Indonesia promoted palm oil bioenergy in Russia during the INNOPROM 2026 industrial exhibition.
  • Indonesia secured 13 industrial MoUs at the INNOPROM 2026 event.

Other

President Prabowo inaugurated five dams across four provinces (Aceh and Bali), works constructed by state-owned PT Brantas Abipraya that are expected to strengthen the national economic growth ecosystem after Waskita Karya built 29 dams over the past decade. The president emphasized that "no other nation will pity us" and urged Indonesians to rely on their own capabilities.

  • Energy and Mineral Resources Minister is considering Aceh's request for onshore processing of Andaman gas resources.
  • An energy minister stated that Indonesia's B50 biodiesel program could save Rp 177 trillion, while also improving farmer welfare and CPO value.
  • The government is planning to develop a northern Bali air hub through expansion of Lt. Col. Wisnu Airfield.
  • The Health Ministry is preparing the first provincial hospital in Highland Papua province.
  • The government targets 40,000 village cooperatives to be established by year-end.
